name: El Mayflower
source:
The country is under strict control with secret police sniffing around everywhere. All culture activities are forbidden and offenders thrown to prison. One day touch female inspector crashes in youth's place to crack him down. However, she still remains human traits, so the youth starts to get gradually attracted to her.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
国家处于严格管控之下，秘密警察四处窥探。所有文化活动都被禁止，违法者会被投入监狱。一天，一名好色女检查员闯入年轻人的住处，打算严厉打击他。然而，她仍保留着人性的一面，于是年轻人逐渐被她吸引。

[来源：[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-december-2004-to-heart-2.html]vndbreview[/url]]
